claim_text: We are also proud to announce that we have secured a green premium on small volumes of gold sold during FY25, validating our efforts to ensure traceability, emissions reduction and sustainability.
metric_name: Gold sold at a premium to the prevailing spot price for gold
context_text: We are pleased to report that SMO- certified gold produced by Bellevue Gold was purchased by a high-end luxury jeweller and in collaboration with ABC Refinery and SMO, we have sold responsibly mined gold bullion – hence selling to both the jewellery and bullion markets. Sales were completed at a premium to the prevailing spot price for gold.
label: Partially Supported
rationale_short: The context directly states that sales were completed at a premium to the prevailing spot price for gold, which fully supports the claim that Bellevue Gold secured a green premium during FY25.
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that the company “secured a green premium” on small volumes of gold sold during FY25, and that this outcome validates its traceability, emissions reduction, and sustainability efforts. No evidence fields were provided to substantiate any part of this: there is no documentation of FY25 gold sales, no definition or amount of the “green premium,” no volumes, no dates, no buyer/contract terms, and no traceability or emissions-reduction data tied to the sold gold. As a result, the claim is not meaningfully verified by the provided evidence.
